# Comfy Colab Kit

> Wake-on-demand ComfyUI on Google Colab. A lightweight aiohttp gateway (comfy-gate) that runs either 100% locally on your Mac/PC (zero VPS, zero domain, zero Cloudflare setup) or on a cloud Linux VPS behind Cloudflare Access. Shows a Hugging-Face-Space-style wake page, starts one shared Colab GPU session via the colab CLI with resilient multi-GPU allocation (A100 80G --high-mem → G4 96G → L4 24G auto-fallback, retry backoff, session reconciliation, and high_mem-aware CU accounting), streams progress to every viewer over SSE, reverse-proxies ComfyUI (incl. /ws), and auto-stops on idle, max session, quiet hours or compute-unit budget. 7 built-in profiles: MOSS-Image, MiniMax-H3-Image, MiniMax-H3-Video (TriPRISM), FLUX.2 Klein 4B, Wan 2.2 & LTX-Video (T2V/I2V), SD 3.5, and Qwen-Image.

## For Autonomous AI Agents (Local Execution)
1. **Bootstrap**: Run `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml up -d` or `python3 -m gate` (requires `AUTH_DISABLED=true` in `.env`).
2. **Inspect**: Call `GET http://localhost:8080/_gate/healthz`, `GET http://localhost:8080/_gate/profiles` (includes `accelerator`, `fallback_accelerators`, `high_mem`), and `GET http://localhost:8080/_gate/status` (includes live `accelerator` and `cu.per_hour`).
3. **Connect via MCP**: Spawn `ckit mcp --gate-url http://localhost:8080` via stdio. Zero tokens or Cloudflare headers required.
4. **Generate**: Call `gate_wake` (or `POST /_gate/wake` with optional `"accelerator": "A100" | "G4" | "L4"`) with a profile (e.g. `flux-klein`, `wan-ltx-video`, or `minimax-h3-video`), queue prompts with `gate_txt2img` / `gate_img2img`, and call `gate_stop` upon completion.

## API
- [apps/gate/openapi.yaml](apps/gate/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 for /_gate/*
- [packages/schemas/profile.schema.json](packages/schemas/profile.schema.json): profile JSON Schema

- [profiles/examples/minimax-h3-video/README.md](profiles/examples/minimax-h3-video/README.md): MiniMax-H3-Video (TriPRISM 8-step Ref2V/I2V/T2V + stereo audio, `h3-extend` w/ `ColorTransfer` anchor, `h3-extender-latent` zero-MP4-drift latent chaining, Fun ControlNet-Union 2.0 V2V, RelayVSR/Latent upscaling; `A100 80G → G4 96G → L4 24G` auto-fallback via `model_aliases_by_gpu` & `overrides_by_gpu`, `~39.63 GB` core / `~32.76 GB` L4 / `~49.25 GB` full) profile
